name: us030-unattended-env-only
description: 030 US4: an unattended/CI run — all three settings (SPEC_KIT_JIRA_BASE_URL, JIRA_EMAIL, JIRA_API_TOKEN) supplied as environment variables only, no config.yml, no personal.yml, no credential store, no JIRA_PAT_COMMAND. Succeeds and prompts for nothing — exit 0, one successful mirror call. Byte-identical across ports.
